column3: NASB follows the critical text (“Boasting is necessary, though it is not profitable”).
NASB sets off the aside with dashes and renders “until the third heaven” as “to the third heaven.”
NASB follows the critical text (“apart from”); it adds “how” and sets off the aside with dashes.
NASB renders “declaration” as “words.”
NASB follows the critical text; “concerning” is rendered “on behalf of.”
NASB adds “from this.”
NASB follows the critical text (“for this reason”); “become conceited” is rendered “exalting myself,” and the last clause is set off with a dash.
NASB renders “begged” as “entreated.”
NASB follows the critical text without “My” before “power”; “is finished” is rendered “is perfected,” and “rest upon” is “dwell in.”
NASB follows the critical text; “take pleasure” is rendered “am well content,” and “hardships” is “distresses.”
NASB follows the critical text without “boasting”; it renders “was obliged” as “should have” and “nothing” as “a nobody.”
NASB follows the critical text without “in”; it adds “true” and renders “in all perseverance” as “with all perseverance.”
NASB adds “treated as.”
NASB follows the critical text without “to you”; “ought to treasure up” is rendered “are not responsible to save up.”
NASB follows the critical text (“If I love you the more, am I to be loved the less?”); “utterly spent” is rendered “expended.”
NASB renders “let it be” as “be that as it may,” adds “fellow that I am,” and renders “caught you by trickery” as “took you in by deceit.”
NASB renders “exploit” as “take advantage of” and casts the question as “have I?”
NASB adds “to go” and restructures the questions.
NASB follows the critical text (“All this time”); it adds “Actually,” renders “before God” as “in the sight of God,” and “edification” as “upbuilding.”
NASB follows the critical text with singular “strife, jealousy”; “anger” is rendered “angry tempers,” and “conceit” is “arrogance.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “I am afraid” and renders “humble” as “humiliate.”
